load_correct_tokenizer: load a Hugging Face tokenizer and fix chat template compatibility for generation
fix_sentencepiece_tokenizer: fix a sentencepiece tokenizer by remapping token strings in the protobuf model file
check_tokenizer: check a tokenizer for out-of-bounds token IDs and repair or reload it if needed
fix_sentencepiece_gguf: extend a sentencepiece tokenizer.model with user-defined tokens from added_tokens.json for GGUF export
patch_sft_trainer_tokenizer: patch TRL SFTTrainer DPOTrainer and KTOTrainer with tokenizer fixes and untrained token handling
